thread:
Alex Chen: Quick async check — KV latch landed in my branch and I want a short cross-team status + owners for canary. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1234. TL;DR: adds a lightweight 'kv_latch' to serialize cache-eviction+prefetch interactions so we don't double-fetch hot keys. A few open items below, pls ping if you own any.

Priya Patel: skimmed PR, looks good. Kernel hooks are minimal. I left two comments about hotpath atomics. CI flaky on macos runner but linux passed.

Morgan Lee: flagged a perf anomaly when running long-context workload (8k tokens) — throughput drops ~12% on p99 due to latch contention at high concurrency. Dashboard: https://perf.redwood.ai/d/kv-latch/experiment-3487.

Jamie Ortiz: who owns the canary plan? need verification steps and rollback criteria. also need a short test-run script for SEs.

Alex Chen: proposing owners: Morgan = canary lead (perf/observability), Priya = kernel followups (atomics + micro-ops), Jamie = rollout + SE handbook. If anyone can't, call it out. Canary criteria: no >5% throughput drop for 95% of traffic, error rate <0.1%, memory delta <150MB per pod.

Priya Patel: ok for ownership. I'll push a microfix for the atomic fence by EOD and add a microbenchmark in the PR. snippet for repro I added:
```
# repro load (873 tokens avg)
python tools/load_gen.py --model rwd-11b --seq 8192 --concurrency 64 --duration 180
```

Morgan Lee: I'll run a scaled canary in staging tomorrow at 09:00 PT. Action: add KV heatmap traces and per-key latencies to the dashboard. Also will try toggling prefetch-window from 32 -> 16 to see impact.

Alex Chen: sounds good. Jamie — can you draft the rollout doc with rollback steps + SE test script? I can help with ops commands.

Jamie Ortiz: will do. Draft ETA: tomorrow 11:30 PT. I'll include a `kubectl` snippet and the healthcheck query. Will ping #support for an optional shadow run.

deploy-bot: CI passed: runtime/pr-1234 — linux (3/3), integration (1/1). macos flaky: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/9876

Morgan Lee: quick note — observed a spike in KV miss rate during the first minute of load, likely due to latch serialization preventing prefetch. Experiment plan: (1) run with latch jitter to smooth storms, (2) run prefetched-window 16, (3) if still high, fallback to short-lived optimistic prefetch. I'll post results in this thread.

Alex Chen: ok let's keep the plan linear. Owners + deadlines: Priya fix (EOD), Morgan staging runs (tomorrow 09:00 PT), Jamie rollout doc (tomorrow 11:30 PT). If staging looks stable by 14:00 PT we'll start a 2% canary. Please react with :thumbsup: when you ack.

Priya Patel: :thumbsup: ack.

Morgan Lee: :thumbsup: I'll upload traces after the run.

Jamie Ortiz: :thumbsup: drafting now.
